dialog.browserCheckWhy: Before you can paint, the game asks your browser to prove it's a browser. That check didn't complete, so the server turned the click down.
dialog.browserCheckFix: Reloading the page usually fixes it. If it keeps happening, an ad blocker or a privacy extension is probably blocking {host} — allow it for this site and try again.

dialog.vpnWhy: The server turned down your last click: it arrived from a VPN or proxy address, and those don't get to claim tiles.
dialog.vpnFix: Turn yours off and reload to carry on conquering. You can keep watching the planet either way — everything else still works.
